nodes.name: domain_utils.py is supporting cross-layer vocabulary, not a new source of truth

source_of_truth.scope: canonicalization of free-text/legacy business-domain vocabulary into identity.Domain / core.router.route_decision.RouterDomain values
source_of_truth.precedence: identity.Domain and RouterDomain remain the canonical business-domain enums; domain_utils.py is a supporting alias/canonicalization layer over them, consumed by callers in more than one layer, and does not itself decide or own a domain value

notes: Registered to resolve a Context Librarian REVIEW_REQUIRED finding: domain_utils.py is consumed by marketing_gateway.py (layer.marketing), core/lead_event_writer.py, and weekly_summary.py — no single existing catalog layer owns all three callers, so it does not belong exclusively in layer.marketing's code_paths.

This node registers the module as cross-layer supporting metadata, not as a new runtime authority: it must never be extended to originate a domain value that identity.Domain/RouterDomain do not already define (see UnknownBusinessDomain in domain_utils.py, which fails closed on an unapproved alias).

core/lead_event_writer.py and weekly_summary.py remain outside all 7 existing catalog layers as of this registration — that gap is unrelated to domain_utils.py itself and is not resolved by this decision.

context_librarian.registration.purpose: canonicalizes free-text/legacy business-domain vocabulary into identity.Domain/RouterDomain values for marketing, lead-event, and reporting call sites; not itself a runtime authority

nodes.name: TMA presentational UI primitives are shared frontend infrastructure, not layer-owned

source_of_truth.scope: generic, stateless React presentational components under tma-frontend/src/components/ui/
source_of_truth.precedence: the feature screens that consume them (e.g. Ventures.tsx) own business behavior; these primitives own layout/markup only and decide nothing

notes: Registered to resolve a Context Librarian REVIEW_REQUIRED finding after PR #625 (VUX-0 Ventures foundations): these 4 files are pure, prop-driven React components (no fetch/API/state/side effects — verified by inspection) currently consumed only by Ventures.tsx.

None of the 7 existing catalog layers legitimately own generic TMA UI primitives — layer.marketing's MarketingStatus.tsx precedent is domain-specific (F23 Marketing Bridge status surface), not a generic-component precedent, so folding these in there would be a false assignment. layer.ux_f52's scope is backend user-message formatting/channel rendering, not TMA screen markup.

This node registers the files as non-authoritative shared frontend infrastructure only, mirroring decision.business_domain_vocabulary's pattern — it does not create a new runtime layer and does not claim ownership of Ventures.tsx or any other consumer screen. Ventures.tsx itself predates this catalog's anchor commits and remains unregistered in all 7 layers — a pre-existing gap, unrelated to and not resolved by this decision.

Scope is deliberately the 4 named files only, not a blanket exemption for tma-frontend/src/components/ui/ — future additions to that directory must be evaluated individually, not assumed to fall under this node.

context_librarian.registration.purpose: generic presentational UI primitives (layout/markup only, no business logic or I/O) shared across TMA screens; not itself a runtime authority for any business domain
